entities.summary: Ertharin Cousin is an American lawyer who served as the twelfth executive director of the United Nations World Food Programme from 2012 to 2017. Following the completion of her term, Cousin became Payne Distinguished Professor at Stanford University's Freeman Spogli Institute for International Studies, distinguished fellow at the Center on Food Security and the Environment and the Center on Democracy, Development and the Rule of Law, accepted an appointment as a distinguished fellow with the Chicago Council on Global Affairs, and became a trustee on the UK based Power of Nutrition Board of Directors.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As the twelfth executive director of the United Nations World Food Programme from 2012 to 2017, Ertharin Cousin played a crucial role in addressing global hunger and malnutrition. Her leadership helped secure $23 billion in funding for food security initiatives.
